items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: How about Albert Nicholas? ... That was George, wasn't George Nicholas, Netflix. You remember him, don't you? Yeah. He's in Paris.

ctx.x: Say, was he reliable? Yeah. Good, I... He played in the little Joe's place once. Joe had his teeth fixed, you know. Played about two weeks. People like to throw the place down in South Carolina, you know. They pay for white people, you know. Down on, uh... Clayborne and Frenchman. And then they stopped, they stopped them once.
